case_number: Criminal Appeal No. 3023 of 2023 (Arising out of S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 4493 of 2023)
summary: Compliance with Section 19(1)(i) of Juvenile Justice Act; mandatory inquiry by Children's Court on whether trial of juvenile as adult is needed; preliminary assessment by Board under Section 15 not final; High Court error in treating transfer order under Section 18(3) as conclusive; trial court must conduct fresh inquiry; case may be transferred to POCSO Special Court; appeal allowed with direction to comply.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.15
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.18(3)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.19(1)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Model Rules, 2016 r.13
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court and Trial Court orders set aside; direction to Children's Court to comply with Section 19(1)(i) inquiry requirement; potential administrative transfer to POCSO Special Court.
